events.text: P: Morning. Could you take me to the university, the main entrance? D: Of course. Nice day for it, finally some sun. P: Yeah, after two weeks of rain. I almost forgot what it looks like.

D: Are you a student there, or do you work at the university? P: I teach, actually. First lecture at nine, and I haven't finished my slides. D: Ha. Then I'll drive carefully, so you can work in the back.
